gaps.sentence: This is ___ second time you've been late this week.
He was sent to ___ prison for armed robbery.
gaps.explanation: 'Be sent to prison' (as a prisoner) takes no article; visiting the building is 'go to the prison'.
'Inflation' as a general economic concept takes no article.

gaps.sentence: He plays ___ violin in the youth orchestra.
He earns fifty thousand pounds ___ year.
gaps.explanation: 'Fifty thousand a year' — 'a' = per in rates.

gaps.sentence: It was ___ best meal I've ever had.

gaps.explanation: Both 'happiness' and 'money' are general here, so no article for either gap.

gaps.sentence: She was appointed ___ managing director at just thirty-four.
gaps.explanation: After 'appoint/elect/name + unique role' no article is used.
